slides.texte_overlay:
how to be a good friend
to someone with ADHD

1. send reminders without
making it a big deal.

"see you at 7 tomorrow!"
is a small kindness

2. don't count the late minutes.

they were probably ready
an hour early and still
somehow got stuck

3. invite them to do the
boring stuff with you.

groceries, laundry, errands.
everything is easier
with company

4. let them change topics.

the conversation isn't lost.
it just took a detour
through 3 other ideas

5. say yes to the random plans
sometimes.

a 10pm drive to see the sea
can be the best night of the month

6. check in when they go quiet.

a simple "thinking of you"
can pull someone out
of a long week

save this for
your ADHD friend
